item.text:
I isolated the randomized seed-57 divergence and confirmed it is a clean all-alive counterexample.

Pre-recovery state:

```
replicas 0-2: status=4 cmds=[{1 7 [99 104 111 115 101 110]}]  // "chosen", COMMITTED
replicas 3-4: no instance
```

Recovery was initiated by replica 3 (which lacked the value）， yielding:

```
replica 0: status=4 cmds=[{1 7 [99 104 111 115 101 110]}]   // "chosen"
replica 1: status=4 cmds=[{1 7 [99 104 111 115 101 110]}]   // "chosen"
replica 2: status=4 cmds=[{1 7 [99 104 111 115 101 110]}]   // "chosen"
replica 3: status=4 cmds=[{0 0 []}]                          // NOOP
replica 4: status=4 cmds=[{0 0 []}]                          // NOOP
```

Thus a value already committed on a majority was lost on the two recovering replicas. This is a deterministic randomized counterexample of F1 and strengthens the primary safety result.

The 100-seed campaign summary is 41 pass / 58 NOOP-on-all losses / 1 mixed divergence, with seed 57 isolated in `TestInvestigationRandomFaultSeed57`.
